subject: Stitching a compact demo + recording option — Vendisphere
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Olson <daniel@vendisphere.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick intake + proposed demo window (30–45m)

Hi Daniel — thanks for taking the intro call yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to run a compact walkthrough focused on the sections you flagged: latency/cost controls and private deployment options.

Proposed slots this week (PT):
- Tue 5/26 10:00–10:45
- Wed 5/27 08:30–09:15

Marissa (SE) will do the live demo; Hannah and I will join for Q&A and next steps. If your execs prefer, we can record the session and follow up with a 20-minute live Q&A tailored to questions.

I attached a short one-pager to frame the agenda. If neither slot works, tell us a tight window (20–30m) and we can compress and focus on the two priority areas.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
<m: +1 415-555-0123>

Attachment: vendisphere-demo-brief.pdf (pdf)
From: Daniel Olson <daniel@vendisphere.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Agarwal <priya@vendisphere.com>
Date: 2026-05-24T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intake + proposed demo window (30–45m)

Hi Karthik — thanks. Exec team is traveling on Tue; Wed morning is possible but only for a 25-minute slot between 08:30–09:00. Also note our security lead will join for the Q&A and needs the recording ahead of time for an internal compliance check.

Can you compress the walkthrough to 25 minutes and record? If not, we can do a 45-minute session next week but unsure about exec availability.

Best,
Daniel
Director of Product, Vendisphere
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Olson <daniel@vendisphere.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-25T07:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intake + proposed demo window (30–45m)

On Mon, May 24, 2026 at 11:03 AM Daniel Olson <daniel@vendisphere.com> wrote:
> Can you compress the walkthrough to 25 minutes and record?

Thanks for the heads-up, Daniel. I can absolutely do a 25-minute focused walkthrough:
- 10 min: targeted architecture + latency/cost levers (live)
- 10 min: private deployment and security highlights (slides + short demo snippet)
- 5 min: immediate next steps / closing

Two quick notes from our side: I have a separate onsite workshop booked 5/26 08:30–10:30 PT that I can't move. Hannah is available during 08:30–09:00 but will be remote and can help moderate the Q&A. If you want Marissa live for full 25 minutes, we can shift to 08:00–08:25 PT on Wed 5/27 (I can be on early).

Option set:
A) Wed 5/27 08:00–08:25 PT — Marissa live + record; Hannah + Karthik on Q&A
B) Wed 5/27 08:30–08:50 PT — Hannah leads demo (compressed) while Marissa provides the recorded deep-dive after the call

If Option B, we'll send the recording within 24 hours for your security lead. Which do you prefer?

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Olson <daniel@vendisphere.com>, Priya Agarwal <priya@vendisphere.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-26T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intake + proposed demo window (30–45m)

Thanks Daniel — appreciate the timing constraints. Given Marissa's onsite overlap, let's go with Option B to keep execs' 08:30 slot and ensure your security lead gets the recording early. Plan below: 

- Wed, 2026-05-27 08:30–08:50 PT: 20-minute compact live walkthrough (Hannah will run live screen)
- Marissa will send a 22-minute recorded demo deep-dive focused on deployment & observability by 5/28 EOB
- Follow-up 20-min Q&A (optional) to be scheduled after your security review (we'll await your availability)

I've attached the updated calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics). Please accept and let us know if you need the recording sooner for the compliance team.

Hannah Schmitt
